system.description:
Play the Inventor if you want to solve problems through tinkering and ingenuity.

Features

Jury Rig. You may Work on a Project to tinker during Rests instead of Extended Rests. You may also perform the Repair Armor Downtime Move by spending an hour and 1 Handful.

Resourceful. When you spend Supply to pull a device or implement from your backpack to solve a problem, you may spend a Hope to gain Advantage on rolls that make use of it. In addition, your Supply only deteriorates on a roll of 1.
